issues.on_page: Local Receipts: Other - Water 26,287.46, Sewer 12,300.53, Water Reserve 10.73
issues.issue: The user's rules put utility fund charges in Utility Charges, not charges for services/fees (Filley uses Utility Charges for the same line). Treating it as charges is an assumption: the page prints 'Other', and Water Reserve 10.73 is probably interest.
Label altered from the printed text (receipts[11] likewise). Keno/lottery is inferred from the fund column, not from the line label.
